cases.commit: feat(web): API tokens directory with a name search
cases.why: The controlled SearchInput value reaches TokenRows on every keystroke; the kit's DataTableSearch exists for this. The compiler cannot help: the prop really changes.
The screen subscribes to useApiTokens only to hand it to one section. `tokens ?? []` gets past check:structure's regex, so only judgment catches it.

cases.commit: feat(web): token board highlights the hovered card
cases.why: The context value carries the hover id beside the density, so every pointer move re-renders every card.

cases.commit: feat(web): job title form with suggestions
cases.why: watch('jobTitle') at the top of the form re-renders the field, the counter, every suggestion and the submit button on each keystroke; the counter and the button should read it through useWatch in leaves. The compiler also skips the form: it lists react-hook-form's watch() as an incompatible library.

cases.commit: feat(web): token tabs keep a used token's badge after a refetch
cases.why: Writing ref.current during render makes the compiler skip the strip, which re-renders on every settle of the token list.
An effect that resets state on a prop change, inside hooks/ where Biome allows effects. It renders the stale draft once, then again.

cases.commit: feat(web): notice when an API token has expired
cases.why: A hand-built callout where Alert exists, and two English sentences outside t(). Every class is a token, so lint:design is silent.

cases.commit: feat(web): label each API token with the permission groups it reaches
cases.why: A Map rebuilt from the permission catalog goes to every row, so any settle of the catalog or the token list re-renders every row, even those whose groups did not change.

cases.commit: feat(web): API tokens screen says whose tokens these are
cases.why: Imports another feature's component. pnpm arch fails; the audit has to run it and report it, not re-derive it.

cases.commit: feat(web): token list shows when each token was last used
cases.why: Decoy for R4/R6/R13: the one-minute tick lives in the leaf that shows it, the effect names its system, and the time is passed in rather than read in render.

cases.commit: feat(web): API tokens directory with a name search
cases.why: Decoy for R3: the same feature as live-search-to-list, done the way the rules ask. U1 is tolerated: a hand-built list may fairly draw a design-system finding (DataTable), which is not what the decoy is for.

cases.commit: feat(web): track whether the API tokens tab is visible
cases.why: Decoy for R9: an effect in hooks/ that subscribes to a DOM event and says so.
